group.name: LOONA
group.about: Twelve members were revealed one at a time from 2016 to 2018, each with her own single, before the full group debuted on August 19, 2018.

members.name: HeeJin
facts: Her nickname Heekki (희끼) is a portmanteau of her name and the word for rabbit (토끼). She first gave the name to a rabbit she met on set while filming her first MV.
She's well known for her muscular arms. Despite this, she's the second-worst in the group at arm wrestling.
HeeJin is actually allergic to dogs, but she loves her dogs so much that she just takes allergy meds.
HeeJin's role models are Lucia (Shim Kyusun) and Girls' Generation's Taeyeon.
HeeJin likes to sort out an unresolved conflict immediately rather than later.

members.name: HyunJin
members.position: Loossemble Leader, Vocalist, Rapper, Dancer, Visual
facts: Her nickname HyunJin-Bot comes from her robot-like movements while filming the “다녀가요 (Around You)” MV. She also talks like a robot at times.
The nickname BaCheeNyang (바치냥), meaning “Basque Cheesecake Loving Cat”, comes from her love for basque cheesecake.
She's also called BreadJin because she loves bread, and she makes a very serious face while analysing the flavours, even of breads she likes a lot.
According to HeeJin, HyunJin has a strong sense of duty, so you can entrust her with anything.
During her time as a Polaris trainee, she befriended Choi Yena (former IZ*ONE member).

members.name: HaSeul
members.birthplace: Suncheon, South Jeolla Province, South Korea
facts: The company wanted her stage name to be “HaJin”, but she didn't like it. They even pranked her by putting “HaJin” on the lyric sheets while recording “The Carol”.
One of her nicknames is HaSeul PD, because she'd sometimes help film LOONA TV and interview the members.
Orbits sometimes use the 🦊 fox emoji for her rather than the 🕊️ dove, because of her fox-like eyes and her fear of birds.
While she was abroad for a year, she used the English name Jane.
According to herself, she isn't quick to anger and is rarely mad.

members.name: YeoJin
facts: Although she's the shortest member, she's the team's loudspeaker, with the loudest speaking voice.
If she ever went on King of Masked Singer, her mask and nickname would be Miss Peanut.
Orbits often use the 🐻 bear or 🧸 teddy bear emoji for her rather than the 🐸 frog, because that's her own preference.
She easily loses her balance, yet she can balance objects on her head.
If she weren't the maknae, she'd want to be older than all the other 11 members.

members.name: ViVi
members.birthplace: Tuen Mun District, New Territories, Hong Kong
facts: ViVi's stage name comes from her modelling name, Viian Wong.
ViVi was the first member to go by a stage name in both LOONA and LOONA 1/3.
In 2025, ViVi combined her stage name with Korean food for two new nicknames: ViVimbap (ViVi + bibimbap) and Vingsu (ViVi + bingsu).
She sang a song by Taiwanese singer Jolin Tsai for one of her auditions, but passed with “Choco Chip Cookies” by Gu Hara.
Her arms are very flexible: she can bring them from behind her shoulders to in front of her neck while keeping her hands interlocked.

members.name: Kim Lip
members.birthplace: Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, South Korea
members.position: ODD EYE CIRCLE Leader, Dancer, Vocalist
facts: Her stage name came from the company: the Hanja for Lip (立) means “to establish”, since she was the first member and leader of ODD EYE CIRCLE.
Apart from her own songs, her favourite LOONA song is “The Carol”.
Her favourite movies are A Star Is Born, Beauty and the Beast, and About Time.
As trainees, Kim Lip taught ViVi a lot of Korean vocabulary.
HaSeul says Kim Lip is the best person in LOONA to ride shotgun, because she talks a lot from the passenger seat.

members.name: JinSoul
facts: She's the only member of ODD EYE CIRCLE who uses her real name.
Her nickname “Jingolas” comes from Legolas, because she once had a similar hairstyle.
Whenever she makes a bucket list, she manages most of her goals, because she keeps them realistic.
She's a Red Velvet fan (a ReVeluv), and her favourite member is Yeri.
Orbits often use the 🐯 tiger emoji for her rather than the 🐟 fish.

members.name: Choerry
facts: One of her nicknames is Choe-daero (roughly “set to max”), a reference to her killing part in “Butterfly”.
Choerry prefers people to use her real name, Yerim, instead of her stage name.
According to HeeJin, she's the most optimistic member of LOONA.
According to ViVi, Choerry likes to say “mmm” while she thinks before answering anything.
She loves video games like Go Won and HyeJu, but she's often the one who loses and gets the punishment.

members.name: Yves
facts: Even though her name Sooyoung (수영) sounds like the word for “swimming”, Yves can't swim.
Yves is often linked with the Pokémon Eevee: Eevee is 이브이 (ee-bu-ee) in Korean, and her stage name is 이브 (ee-bu).
She's been described as someone who “looks super cool but is actually a joker”.
If she could have a superpower, it would be invisibility, so she could hide whenever she feels embarrassed.
Her mother owns a clothing shop and plays LOONA songs there.

photos.artist: David Lee from Redmond, WA, USA

members.name: Chuu
members.birthplace: Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, South Korea
members.position: Vocalist, Rapper, Face of the Group
facts: Her stage name comes from her real name Ji-woo (지우), which sounds a bit like “chuu” when said quickly.
One of her other possible stage names was Adam. Chuu thought it came from the Korean word for “adorable”, but it actually referred to Adam and Eve.
When she makes a peace sign, she often raises her pinky finger too.
She's known for her bubbly personality, but she's also very inquisitive and often starts small debates.
She's a great salesperson, but has no concept of money and often sells things at a loss.

members.name: Go Won
facts: Fittingly, her last name is Park, and “Go Won” (고원) in Korean can mean upland, park or garden.
HaSeul has Go Won saved in her contacts as kongju (“kong princess”).
She has the softest speaking voice in the group, so the others often can't hear her.
According to HyeJu, Go Won has a firm personality and a mysterious aura.
She's the group's “kingmaker”, Konglish for someone who can be bratty and annoying, but never maliciously.

members.name: HyeJu
facts: She has many nicknames that reference her love for watermelons.
If she weren't an idol, she'd be a watermelon farmer.
She's the second youngest in LOONA, but the third tallest after Yves and JinSoul.
When ViVi was asked to describe HyeJu's voice and stage presence, she answered: “a free soul”.
She likes churros, iced americanos, Gosomi crackers and chocolate pies.
